reviewed_sources.result: Public storefront found; no authorized public exportable games catalog. No authenticated/private access attempted.
Search results predominantly PS3 and commercial retail stores; no direct exportable public PS4 catalog identified.
App/catalog claims found; app already exists in free catalog. No public game export identified.
Search indexed YouTube/Crunchyroll/Plex media entries; direct details fetched via web tool timed out or returned HTTP 500. No candidate header obtained.
Public author thread shows CUSA02644 v1.34; download gated behind login/Like and comments report broken links. No gated content accessed or header obtained.
Old Crunchyroll 1.27 links point to inactive Zippyshare/anonfile hosts. Service accounts/subscriptions remain separate from PSN bypass.

Public apps/updates/DLC manifests inspected. 23 apps,12 updates,7 DLC metadata rows. Apps metadata appears erroneous: many unrelated items all named Store/version01.00/size24772608. Do not trust these fields. HF provider unsupported and archive DLC not header checked; none imported.
Six author releases reviewed, predominantly 7z/ctmthm packages for PC/USB tools; no direct PKG release accepted.
Website ships browser payload theme JS and artwork, no public direct PKG files in repository.
Many public ZIP theme files; no direct PKGs/releases. Not imported into native direct-PKG pipeline.
